profile.headline: Manager, Software Development & Engineering at Charles Schwab
profile.summary:
Driven software engineer with experience in the following areas:
Languages: Java/J2EE (20+ years), Groovy, SQL
Frameworks: Spring, Spring Boot, Swagger
Build Tools: Maven, Gradle
Databases: SQL Server, DB2
Testing: JUnit, Mockito
Version Control: Git, GitHub, Bitbucket
Private Cloud: PCF

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Backend developer working on a team to develop and maintain various credit card applications.
• Implement new credit card account closure service using Spring Boot that included new REST APIs
• Facilitate performance tests to identify and resolve bottlenecks in our credit card account closure process
• Implement Apache Kafka to facilitate communication between various dependent micro services
• Review and approve all code changes made by members of the team prior to merging
• Mentor other developers in writing high-quality unit tests to provide over 90% code coverage

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-Stack developer working on a team to develop and maintain the BlazeSV product.
• Lead the UI development work using React and Redux
• Mentored other UI developers to ensure high coding standards and Jest/Enzyme unit test creation
• Used Liquibase to add tables and columns to the Postgres database
• Added REST endpoints to the backend using Spring

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead development of KnowThings IoT simulator product.
• Worked with others to design and code a REST API for the KnowThings IoT simulator product. This API was documented using Swagger annotations.
• Developed much of the backend components using Spring Boot to allow users to capture data from and simulate their IoT devices. This included a suite of JUnit tests using JMockit.
• Lead development efforts to enhance product to scale the number of IoT simulators using a user's network.
• Mentored other developers in good coding practices.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Work on a team to develop and maintain the LISA Test and VSE products.
• Implemented new REST API for the VSE product using Swagger and JAX-RS annotations.
• Lead support team in diagnosing and fixing customer problems relating to our service virtualization software.
• Refactored several key components in web-based Portal application using AngularJS.
• Worked with team to enhance product to run in Docker containers.

positions.title: Senior Technical Lead
positions.description:
Responsible for development and maintenance of the Reimbursement Pro and WebScan Pro products. 
• Work well with others in a fast-paced development environment utilizing SCRUM.
• Successfully used EJBs to delegate work load on application servers thus improving server performance and stability.
• Re-vitalized key product using Ajax and JMS to significantly improve response times and user experience. This had a positive impact on sales.
• Lead team to successfully complete database scale-out project to improve database response times and eliminate single-point of failure.  This was done with a SQL Server database cluster using database replication.
• Adapted core products to utilize both local and cloud storage.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for developing and maintaining J2EE/Java intranet applications for the financial systems group.
• Attended intensive, 3-month J2EE/Java training class after one year. Utilized Unified Process for sound object-oriented application design.
• Lead developer for intranet pricing management application used nationwide. Application developed using Java, JSP, Struts, and Hibernate.
• Played integral role in test price expansion project that helped generate millions of dollars.
• Graduated from 3-month, intensive Cobol training class with highest scores.

educations.schoolName: University of North Carolina at Greensboro
